title: Correct the stale implementation pointers in the bee-herding knowledge area
action: The Pointers section of docs/knowledge/areas/bee-herding/overview.md still cites the pre-Rust-port Node files as the implementation: scripts/dispatch-interlock.mjs, scripts/classify-lane.mjs, packages/bee/lib/herding.mjs and packages/bee/tests/test_herding_cli.mjs. None of those files exists in the repository any more. The live implementation is packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding.rs, dispatched from router.rs and listed in catalog.rs, and it carries exactly five verbs: classify-lane, interlock, command-template, herdr-result and herdr-pane-id. Verify each replacement path exists before writing it. Also correct the entry that presents bee herding enable, disable and status as available CLI verbs: they are not built into the current binary and refuse by name, so the manual marker gesture is the only live form — the area text already says this in its Data Dictionary, so make the Pointers section agree with it rather than contradicting it. Change nothing else in the area: its Open Gaps move in later phases, not this one.

truths: Every implementation path named in the Pointers section resolves to a file that exists.
The Pointers section names packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding.rs as the CLI verb implementation.
The Pointers section no longer presents enable, disable or status as verbs the binary provides.
